alternates.fact: Lake Manyara's tree-climbing lions have a reputation for a unique behavior not seen in many other places in the world.
alternates.why: I've been to Manyara and heard the tree-climbing lion thing my whole life, so it's not news to me, and the fact doesn't even say why they do it or how weird it really is — it just says they have a 'reputation', which is nothing.
alternates.title: Tree-climbing lions in Lake Manyara National Park
alternates.claim: Tanzania is one of only two places in the world where lions are known to regularly climb and rest in trees, particularly in Lake Manyara National Park.

candidate.passage: The tree-climbing lions of Lake Manyara have gained quite a reputation for this unique behavior, which is not seen in many other places in the world.
